Privacy Policy

How we handle information you choose to share.

When you contact Citrus Custom Apparel, we use the details you provide to respond, prepare quotes, arrange production, and coordinate delivery. Our quote form prepares an email in your own email app; submitting the form does not itself send or store the information.

Email is handled through our email provider, and our website hosting provider may process technical request data to operate and secure the site. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. We do not currently use advertising trackers on this site.

Do not send payment-card details by email. For privacy questions or requests concerning information you have shared, contact hello@citruscustomapparel.com.
